templates.name: Meeting notes
templates.description: Who met, what was discussed, what was decided and who does what next.
templates.title: Meeting notes {date}

content.text: Mention everybody who took part, with @ and their name
What should this meeting decide or clear up?
Sum up each topic and what was said about it
Write down each decision, and link its decision record if it has one
Say who does what, and by when

templates.name: How-to guide
templates.description: Step by step instructions for getting one task done.

content.text: Say in a sentence or two what this guide helps the reader do.
List what the reader needs first: access, tools or knowledge.
Describe the last step and what the reader sees when it worked
Link pages that go further or cover similar tasks

templates.name: Troubleshooting article
templates.description: A known problem, how to recognise it and how to fix it.

content.text: Describe what goes wrong, as the person who runs into it sees it.
Quote an error message, a log line or a behaviour that points to this problem
Explain why it happens, as far as it is known.
Describe the first step of the fix
Describe how to check that the fix worked
Warn about anything the fix could break, or leave this out.

templates.name: Retrospective
templates.description: A team looks back on a stretch of work and agrees what to change.
templates.title: Retrospective {date}

content.text: Which sprint, milestone or weeks this looks back on
Name something that slowed the team down or got in its way
Name one change, who looks after it and how the team will know it helped

templates.name: Decision record
templates.description: One decision, the options weighed and why this one was chosen.

content.text: Proposed, accepted or replaced by a later decision
What makes a decision necessary? Describe the situation and the forces at play.
Describe an option with what speaks for and against it
State the option chosen and why it won.
What becomes easier or harder because of this decision?

templates.name: Product requirements
templates.description: What a product or feature must do, for whom and why.

content.text: Why are we doing this? Describe the problem and the outcome we want.
Link designs, or describe how people will use it.
Note what still needs an answer, and who can give it
List what this will not do, so nobody expects it

templates.name: Project plan
templates.description: Goals, scope, milestones, people and risks of a project in one place.

content.text: Describe the project in a few sentences: what it delivers and for whom.
State a goal and how its success will be measured
Say what is part of the project and what is not.
Mention each person and their role
How we lower or handle it
